messages:
Nora Li: Hi team - kickoff for Voyager Health onboarding. Objective: pilot live inside 30 days, capture renewal-risk signals and unblock integrations. Quick owners? :wave:
James Park: I'll take API integration + sample mapping. Plan a smoke test by day 4 and post examples here.
Rina Gupta: I'll own enablement + adoption playbook. Propose two 45-min sessions: API + ops (wk1) and prompts + evaluation (wk2).
Marco Silva: I'll handle data ingestion & compliance. Need sample payloads and their DPA/SOC2. Also will draft redaction rules if PHI/PII present.
Nora Li: I emailed their security lead for SOC2/DPA and asked for payloads. If no reply by EOD, I'll escalate. Exec sponsor is unclear; we should secure one before week 2.
James Park: Infra note: start on a small Dedicated pool, batch size 6, prefix-cache on. That should keep p95 latency predictable.
Rina Gupta: Enablement checklist v0:
- Day 0: Stakeholder intros & roles
- Day 2: API walkthrough + keys
- Day 6: Prompt design & 10-case eval
- Day 12: Failover, monitoring & runbook
- Day 30: Pilot review + renewal conversation
I'll drop slides after session 1.
Marco Silva: Risks: renewal-risk: medium (procurement timeline unclear), integration complexity: low, data-risk: possible PHI - will propose minimization and KMS notes within 48h.
Nora Li: Success criteria proposal: 1) Pilot flows 3/3 success, 2) p95 latency < 350ms, 3) error rate < 1% during pilot window. Thoughts?
James Park: Agree. Also add cost guardrail: cap on tokens per session and alert if predicted spend > threshold.
Rina Gupta: We'll run pre/post prompt regression on the 10-case set and surface regressions in the playbook. I can own the eval table.
Marco Silva: I'll add privacy checklist and retention options to the tracker and call out required KMS/HSM access.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite: "Voyager Health - Onboarding Kickoff" scheduled for 2025-11-05 09:30 PST (invite sent).
Nora Li: Action items recap:
- Nora: chase exec intro + SOC2/DPA (today)
- James: smoke test + sample mappings (day 4)
- Rina: publish enablement schedule + eval set (wk1)
- Marco: privacy redaction plan + KMS notes (48h)
If any blocker, post here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
